definitions.explanation: Weak light, such as the glow before sunrise or after sunset, or light coming faintly from a window or a distant lamp.

examples.japanese: {薄明|うすあ}かり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked through the dim light.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{薄明|うすあ}かり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}む→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧。
examples.english: The faint morning light comes in through the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{街灯|がいとう}→街灯：14025_gaitou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{薄明|うすあ}かり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たよ}り→頼り：14634_tayori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: Relying on the faint light of the street lamps, I made my way home along the dark road.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薄明|うすあ}かり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in the dim light
- ⟦{夜明|よあ}け→夜明け：03655_yoake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{薄明|うすあ}かり: the half-light of dawn
- {薄明|うすあ}かり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧: faint light shines in

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{薄暗|うすぐら}い→薄暗い：09122_usugurai⟧: dim, gloomy (an adjective describing the place). {薄明|うすあ}かり is the light itself.
- ⟦{薄明|はくめい}→薄明：25609_hakumei⟧: twilight, the technical and literary word, also used in astronomy.
